services.name: Themed Cruises
services.desc: Below you’ll see our different themed and holiday cruises. Keep an eye on this page mate to see what’s cooking in the upcoming months! Celebrate America’s 250th Anniversary aboard the legendary Pieces of Eight Pirate Ship during the inaugural Salty Sam’s Patriot Boat Parade on Saturday, June 27th! Join the crew of the Pieces of Eight Pirate Ship for one of the most popular events of the year! The Fort Myers Beach Holiday Boat Parade! This is hands down one of the best ways to ring in the new year on Fort Myers Beach. services.name: Private Charters
services.desc: Looking for a one-of-a-kind venue on Fort Myers Beach? Charter the Pieces of Eight, our 65-foot Spanish galleon, for your next private party, celebration, or corporate event! This mighty ship can stow over 90 seaworthy guests, making it perfect for gatherings big or small - from birthdays and weddings to office outings and sunset celebrations. Every Private Pirate Charter is tailored to your crew’s wishes. Our lively pirate staff can fill your voyage with music, games, jokes, sword fights, mutiny, treasure hunts, and plenty of swashbuckling fun - or keep things smooth sailing with relaxing tunes and tropical cocktails.
